delivery-order.text: The work begins with a clean model-bound baseline and draft pull request. The coder then splits three responsibilities behind one facade while keeping verification's extra live policy and window checks distinct from attachment. Independent review and exact-head checks precede the handoff.

evidence-limits-and-gates.text: A build alone cannot prove a script identity refusal. A supported local devnet check must accept the intact manifest and reject a changed script identity. It does not prove every attachment query. The retained journey mirror check stays a separately named evidence limit.
